title: Covalent aptamers: agents with promising therapeutic and diagnostic potential
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00133A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Savannah Albright, Jessica Boette, Mary Cacace, Alexander Deiters
Covalent aptamers are a new class of oligonucleotide reagents. Covalent target engagement uniquely addresses limitations of traditional aptamers, resembling advances in covalent drug discovery.
